hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْتَ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ ، فَإِذَا ضِبَاب فِيهَا بَيْضٌ ، وَمَعَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ، وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ ، فَقَالَ : " مِنْ أَيْنَ لَكُمْ هَذَا ؟ " فَقَالَتْ : أَهْدَتْهُ لِي أُخْتِي هُزَيْلَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ ، فَقَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، وَخَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ : " كُلَا " ، فَقَالَا : أَوَلَا تَأْكُلُ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ؟ فَقَالَ : " إِنِّي تَحْضُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ حَاضِرَةٌ " ، قَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ : أَنَسْقِيكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مِنْ لَبَنٍ عِنْدَنَا ، فَقَالَ : " نَعَمْ " ، فَلَمَّا شَرِبَ ، قَالَ : " مِنْ أَيْنَ لَكُمْ هَذَا ؟ " فَقَالَتْ : أَهْدَتْهُ لِي أُخْتِي هُزَيْلَةُ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَرَأَيْتِكِ جَارِيَتَكِ الَّتِي كُنْتِ اسْتَأْمَرْتِينِي فِي عِتْقِهَا ، أَعْطِيهَا أُخْتَكِ وَصِلِي بِهَا رَحِمَكِ ، تَرْعَى عَلَيْهَا فَإِنَّهُ خَيْرٌ لَكِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Yasar: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the house of Maymunah bint al-Harith, and there were lizards (dabb) with eggs in it, and with him were Abdullah ibn Abbas and Khalid ibn al-Walid. He said: 'From where did you get this?' She said: 'My sister Huzaylah bint al-Harith gifted it to me.' So he said to Abdullah ibn Abbas and Khalid ibn al-Walid: 'Eat.' They said: 'Will you not eat, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Indeed, a presence from Allah comes to me.' Maymunah said: 'Shall I give you drink from some milk we have, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Yes.' When he drank, he said: 'From where did you get this?' She said: 'My sister Huzaylah gifted it to me.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'What do you think about your slave girl whom you consulted me about freeing? Give her to your sister and maintain your kinship ties through her, she will take care of her, for that is better for you.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْتَ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَأُتِيَ بِضَبٍّ مَحْنُوذٍ فَأَهْوَى إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِيَدِهِ ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُ النِّسْوَةِ اللَّاتِي فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ : أَخْبِرُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ ، فَقِيلَ : هُوَ ضَبٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، فَرَفَعَ يَدَهُ ، فَقُلْتُ : أَحَرَامٌ هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ؟ فَقَالَ : " لَا ، وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ " ، قَالَ خَالِدٌ : فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَنْظُرُ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Khalid ibn al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah: He entered with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the house of Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, and a roasted lizard (dabb) was brought. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ reached out his hand toward it, then some of the women who were in the house of Maymunah said: 'Inform the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about what he is about to eat from.' So it was said: 'It is a lizard, O Messenger of Allah.' So he raised his hand. I said: 'Is it forbidden, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'No, but it was not in the land of my people, so I find myself having an aversion to it.' Khalid said: 'So I pulled it and ate it, while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was watching.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا نَادَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، مَا تَرَى فِي الضَّبِّ ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَسْتُ بِآكِلِهِ وَلَا بِمُحَرِّمِهِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar: A man called out to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what do you think about the lizard (dabb)?' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I do not eat it, nor do I forbid it.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ ، أَنَّ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ أَخْبَرَهُ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ أَبِي زُهَيْرٍ وَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَزْدِ شَنُوءَةَ ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، وَهُوَ يُحَدِّثُ نَاسًا مَعَهُ عِنْدَ بَاب الْمَسْجِدِ ، فَقَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ : " مَنِ اقْتَنَى كَلْبًا لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ زَرْعًا وَلَا ضَرْعًا ، نَقَصَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ قِيرَاطٌ " . قَالَ : أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ؟ فَقَالَ : إِي وَرَبِّ هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr: He was a man from Azd Shanu'ah, from among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he was narrating to people with him at the door of the mosque. He said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever keeps a dog that does not benefit him in cultivation or livestock, a qirat will be decreased from his deeds every day."' It was said: 'Did you hear this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?' He said: 'Yes, by the Lord of this mosque.'

Keeping dogs for no purpose
Reward being decreased for keeping unnecessary dogs

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " مَنِ اقْتَنَى كَلْبًا إِلَّا كَلْبًا ضَارِيًا أَوْ كَلْبَ مَاشِيَةٍ ، نَقَصَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ قِيرَاطَانِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever keeps a dog except a hunting dog or a dog for livestock, two qirats will be decreased from his deeds every day.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " رَأْسُ الْكُفْرِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ ، وَالْفَخْرُ وَالْخُيَلَاءُ فِي أَهْلِ الْخَيْلِ وَالْإِبِلِ ، وَالْفَدَّادِينَ أَهْلِ الْوَبَرِ ، وَالسَّكِينَةُ فِي أَهْلِ الْغَنَمِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The head of disbelief is toward the east, and pride and arrogance are in the people of horses and camels, and the loud-voiced Bedouins who live in tents of hair, and tranquility is in the people of sheep.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرَ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِ غَنَمٌ يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ ، وَمَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'It is soon that the best wealth of a Muslim will be sheep with which he follows the mountain peaks and places of rain, fleeing with his religion from tribulations (fitan).'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " لَا يَحْتَلِبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَاشِيَةَ أَحَدٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ ، أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْتَى مَشْرُبَتُهُ فَتُكْسَرَ خِزَانَتُهُ فَيُنْتَقَلَ طَعَامُهُ ؟ وَإِنَّمَا تَخْزُنُ لَهُمْ ضُرُوعُ مَوَاشِيهِمْ أَطْعِمَاتِهِمْ ، فَلَا يَحْتَلِبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَاشِيَةَ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Let no one milk anyone's livestock without his permission. Would any of you like it if someone came to his upper chamber and broke his storage container and took his food? Indeed, the udders of their livestock store their food for them, so let no one milk anyone's livestock except with his permission.'

plainChains: Malik ibn Anas -> Nafi' -> Ibn Umar -> Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

potential_issues.impact: This is minimal as this is the famous 'Golden Chain' (al-Silsilah al-Dhahabiyyah): Malik narrating from Nafi' from Ibn Umar. This chain is considered one of the most authentic chains in hadith transmission, and the 'an is not problematic here due to the well-established connection between these narrators.

Topics: Prohibition of milking someone's livestock without permission
Analogy of livestock milk to stored food
Property rights over livestock

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا قَدْ رَعَى غَنَمًا " قِيلَ : وَأَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ؟ قَالَ : " وَأَنَا "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated through Malik's balaghat: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is no prophet except that he has herded sheep.' It was said: 'And you, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'And me.'

The narrators between Malik and the Prophet ﷺ are completely omitted

potential_issues.issue: This is a balaghat (بَلَغَهُ) narration with a completely disconnected chain
potential_issues.impact: Balaghat narrations in Muwatta are considered weak by the majority of scholars because the chain is not specified. The narrators between Malik and the Prophet ﷺ are unknown, making it impossible to verify the reliability of the transmission.

Topics: All prophets herding sheep
Prophet Muhammad's ﷺ experience herding sheep
Humility of prophets

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ " يُقَرَّبُ إِلَيْهِ عَشَاؤُهُ فَيَسْمَعُ قِرَاءَةَ الْإِمَامِ وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ ، فَلَا يَعْجَلُ عَنْ طَعَامِهِ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ حَاجَتَهُ مِنْهُ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Nafi': Ibn Umar's dinner would be brought to him, and he would hear the recitation of the Imam while he was in his house, but he would not hasten away from his food until he fulfilled his need from it.

potential_issues.issue: This is a mawquf narration (stops at Ibn Umar, does not reach the Prophet ﷺ)
potential_issues.impact: This narration describes the practice of Ibn Umar, not a statement or action of the Prophet ﷺ. It is reliable as a description of Ibn Umar's practice, but it does not have the same status as a marfu' hadith.

potential_issues.issue: The chain uses 'an (عَنْ) and 'anna (أَنَّ) transmission terms
potential_issues.impact: While these terms can indicate indirect transmission, this is the famous 'Golden Chain' (Malik - Nafi' - Ibn Umar), so the connection is well-established. The use of these terms does not significantly impact the reliability of this narration as a mawquf report.

Topics: Ibn Umar's practice of finishing his meal before going to prayer
Not hastening to prayer when food is present
Incident of Ibn Umar hearing prayer call while eating
